prompt: Name an HTML element.
scope: Use a current element in the MDN list. A bare name or an opening tag works.

prompt: Name a type of HTML input.
scope: Give a current type value for the input element, such as a field, picker, or button.

prompt: Name an HTML attribute.
scope: Use an attribute listed by MDN for an element or for all elements. Attribute names only.

prompt: Name a CSS property.
scope: Use a current property in the MDN list. Custom properties are excluded.

prompt: Name a CSS color keyword.

prompt: Name a CSS pseudo-class.
scope: Use the name, with or without the leading colon. Current pseudo-classes in MDN.

prompt: Name a built-in JavaScript global.
scope: Use an unqualified standard global from MDN, such as a constructor, function, or value. Browser globals are separate.

prompt: Name a method or property on a built-in JavaScript object.

prompt: Name a browser event.
scope: Use a current DOM event in MDN, with or without its on prefix.

prompt: Name a markup or document-formatting language.

prompt: Name a text format used to store data or configuration.

prompt: Name a source-code file extension.
scope: Use an extension GitHub Linguist associates with a programming language. The leading dot is optional.

prompt: Name a Python standard library module.
scope: Use a top-level name from Python’s standard library. Third-party packages are separate.
